error.api_key_missing: DATA_GO_KR_API_KEY is not configured. It is the data.go.kr service key — the same one molit-realestate and kma-weather use.
error.city_code_service_unknown: Unknown service "{{service}}". Available: {{services}}. Each TAGO service publishes its own 도시코드 list, so read the one belonging to the service you are about to call.
error.auth_rejected: data.go.kr rejected the key: {{message}}. Check that this particular API was applied for, and that the stored key is the DECODED form — an already-encoded key gets double-encoded and fails.
error.network: Could not reach the TAGO API: {{message}}
error.subway_id_in_other_service: {{action}} received the subway station id "{{value}}" in {{param}}. Subway ids (MTR…) belong to the subway-* actions; this action uses a different service with its own id namespace and would simply answer with an empty list. Use subway-timetable for subway schedules.
error.same_origin_destination: {{action}} was given "{{value}}" as both origin and destination. The API answers that with an empty list rather than an error, so it is refused here.
